lines.line: Woke up to the morning, phone glow on my face
Pals are waiting for me in our favorite place
Painted up my bedroom, pink sheets and a plan
Said I couldn't build a home, now look at what I can
And every little room I make feels a little more like mine
So come on in, the door is open wide
Your car is parked, I saved a seat inside
We don't need much, just a spot to call our own
Little light, little light, you feel like home
Oh, oh, oh, you feel like home
Took a ride along the long road through the park
Windows down and singing till the sky got dark
Friends from every corner waving on the street
Funny how a little world can make your heart complete
And every little song we play sounds a little more like mine
So come on in, the door is open wide
Your car is parked, I saved a seat inside
We don't need much, just a spot to call our own
Little light, little light, you feel like home
Oh, oh, oh, you feel like home
If the day gets heavy and the night gets long
You can climb the stairs, you can sing along
There's a window glowin', it was left on just for you
Little light, little light, I'll be waitin' too
So come on in, the door is open wide
Your car is parked, I saved a seat inside
We don't need much, just a spot to call our own
Little light, little light, you feel like home
Oh, oh, oh, you feel like home
Oh, Kemy feels like home
